critical_finding.statement: the entire B601 bolt circle lies over the Central_Boss through-bore
critical_finding.consequence: there is no material under the eight screws, so a direct B601-to-boss bolted joint cannot be made.  This is why the base interface was open, and it is a geometry fact, not a modelling omission.
critical_finding.resolution: a flanged transfer ring that picks up M3 at R=45.25 over the bore and reacts onto the boss annulus (r=50..55) and the Adapter_Plate bolt field

parts.note: spans the boss bore: takes the arm's 8xM3 at R=45.25 and reacts them onto the boss annulus at R=52.5; the 2 mm spigot into the r=50 bore centres it and carries shear
parts.dimension_source: measured B601 bolt circle + measured boss bore/annulus

dimensions_mm.holes: 8 x M5 clearance (r=2.75) at R=68.0 into Adapter_Plate
dimensions_mm.ribs: 8 radial ribs, 4 mm, aligned with the M5 pattern

parts.note: second load path: carries moment from the ring out to the Adapter_Plate 160x160 envelope instead of concentrating it on the 5 mm boss annulus
locks the 25 deg clocking that G1 established by mate; without it the joint is friction-only in torsion
collar -> Adapter_Plate (matches P5D M5x16 4 Nm convention)

load_path: B601 base flange (8 x M3, R=45.25, x=210.41)
-> B601_INTERFACE_RING (spans the r=50 bore; spigot carries shear)
-> Central_Boss annulus r=50..55 via 8 x M4 at R=52.5 (x=208.00)
-> B601_LOAD_SPREADING_COLLAR via 8 x M5 at R=68.0
torsion_path: 2 x Ø4 dowel at R=52.5 (25/205 deg) react the clocking torque; the screws are not relied on for torsional location

axial_budget.resolution: the ring is THICKER than the 2.41 mm gap, so the arm cannot stay at its current station AND bolt to a 6 mm ring.  Two options, and this campaign chooses (b):
axial_budget.option_a: move the arm outboard by 3.59 mm -- rejected: it would invalidate every frozen pose and clearance
axial_budget.option_b: recess the ring into the boss bore: the ring's spigot occupies the bore (r<50) for 2.0 mm and its flange occupies the 2.41 mm gap, so only 2.41 mm of flange sits proud

acceptance_tests.criterion: boss-side holes at R=52.5 fall in the r=50..55 annulus
at least 2 dowels or equivalent form-fit
every load path element bolts to the next

mass_accounting: enters the spacecraft EXTERNAL mechanical mass budget; must NOT be added to the accepted B601 URDF inertia
